title: Buses on campus and night transport
summary: MovingMountains live bus tracker and night transport from 10 PM to 6 AM.

posts.md:
**What is it?**

IIT Madras has an internal bus service that connects different parts of the campus. You can use the **MovingMountains** app to check the **live location**, **arrival time**, and **bus frequency**.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**MovingMountains**

Use the app to:

- Track campus buses in real time

- Check estimated arrival times

- Plan your travel across the campus

- Know how frequently buses are running

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Bus Tracking App**

https://mm.themint.space/

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Late-Night Transport**

Finished watching a movie at Phoenix Mall or having a late-night dinner with friends? You don't have to walk back to your hostel.

IIT Madras provides a night transport service between the Academic Zone and the Hostel Zone.

Available: 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM

If It Is Urgent, Call:
Security Section — 044-2257-9999

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Senior's Advice**

If you're staying in a hostel far from the Main Gate (like **Mandakini**), this app can save you a lot of waiting time.

Save the app on your home screen—you'll likely use it frequently during your first few weeks on campus.

During peak hours, buses may be crowded, so check the timings before heading to the bus stop.

Save the Security Section number in your contacts. It's especially useful after late-night movies or dinners when you need a ride back to your hostel.
